content:
# Text Content

The `textContent` property represents the text inside an element. Use it to change what a heading, paragraph, button, or other page element says.
name: Text Content
tips:
- Use `textContent` to update the words shown inside an element.
- Put the new text in quotation marks.
- Make sure the element has been selected before changing its `textContent`.
- `textContent` changes text only, not HTML tags.
- In Web Lab, `textContent` often appears inside event handlers after a button is clicked.
